body.prompt: Instrumental loop, slow waltz in 3/4 at 72 BPM, in A minor, minor key throughout with no major sections. Instrumental only, no vocals with words. A slightly detuned, out-of-tune old music box plays a slow, haunting, memorable little waltz melody in A minor that returns again and again; bowed glass, like a glass harmonica, sustains cold eerie chords; a low dark drone on A hums underneath; a soft low plucked note on each downbeat. Dread and mystery in a sleeping village at night: something is out there in the dark. Never horror, no jump scares, no sudden loud hits. Slow, hypnotic and pleasant to hear for an hour, sparse and quiet so it sits under people talking. Starts immediately with the full arrangement, no intro, same energy throughout, no build-up, no breakdown, no ending and no fade-out, so it can loop seamlessly.
